title: A Least-Squares Weak Galerkin Finite Element Scheme for Cauchy Problems in Convection--Diffusion
summary: We introduce and rigorously analyze a least-squares weak Galerkin (LS-WG) finite element method for the severely ill-posed Cauchy problem of convection--diffusion equations. The proposed framework utilizes weak derivatives defined on a class of discontinuous weak functions, enabling the natural treatment of complex boundary conditions and internal interfaces. A key advantage of the least-squares formulation is that it transforms the underlying non-self-adjoint operator into a discrete linear system that is inherently symmetric and positive definite (SPD).
